about: Flashcards (Josh, 2026-10-21): a production candidate, not used by the app yet. One card per word: the word with its article, the English, which sense the card teaches, and the picture: image is object (one simple thing on plain paper), scene (a wide scene) or none (no picture works: the card uses the English where a picture would go). Images: 1:1, generated at 2k, saved 1200 x 1200 JPEG.
